## About
Auto Perfection Group is a body shop on W Elk Ave in Glendale. We repair cars after accidents, side swipes and hit and runs, and we also take on custom work like bumpers, grills, decals, paint and accessory wiring.
We work on everything from your daily Toyota and Honda to exotics. When your paint is custom, we match it in the shop so the repair blends in.
Our customers have given us a 5 rating across 53 Google reviews. Come by during the week or Saturday morning and we'll take a look.

## Services
- Auto body repair: Body repairs after accidents, side swipes and hit and runs.
- Custom paint color matching: Paint work with in-shop color matching, including custom colors.
- Custom parts installation: Bumpers, grills, decals and clean wiring for off-road accessories and lights.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of cars do you work on?
A: Everything from daily drivers to exotics. One reviewer noted we work on makes from Lamborghini and Ferrari to Toyota and Honda.

Q: Are you open on Saturday?
A: Yes, Saturday from 9:00 AM to 1:30 PM. We're closed on Sunday.

Q: Can you install custom parts?
A: Yes. One customer had front and back bumpers, a custom grill, decals and paint done on their truck.
